text:
Carlos Mendez  
San Francisco, CA | +1 (415) 555-0198 | carlos.mendez@email.com | linkedin.com/in/carlosmendez  

A backend engineer with a focus on scalable systems and high-performance architectures, currently driving adtech innovation at AdvertiseNow Technologies. Leveraging expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native solutions, and database optimization to deliver measurable results across enterprise-scale platforms. Known for delivering robust, maintainable infrastructure that supports real-time ad delivery and inventory management.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **AWS**: Spearheaded the migration of ad inventory management systems to AWS ECS, achieving 40% cost reduction through optimized resource allocation. Engineered auto-scaling solutions for ad campaign dashboards, handling peak loads of 500,000 requests per second.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Redesigned query patterns for ad impression tracking, reducing latency by 30% and improving read throughput by 25% during high-traffic events. Implemented partitioning strategies for terabyte-scale datasets, enabling sub-second query responses.  
- **Go**: Built core components of the ad bidding engine, achieving 15% faster request processing compared to Python-based predecessors. Maintained 99.95% uptime for critical services through rigorous error handling and concurrency patterns.  
- **Python**: Developed internal tools for ad campaign analytics, streamlining reporting workflows and reducing manual data aggregation time by 60%.  
- **REST API Design**: Architected the ad inventory API, supporting 10,000+ concurrent clients with <50ms latency. Integrated rate-limiting and authentication layers to secure $20M+ in ad revenue annually.  
- **Microservices Architecture**: Led the decomposition of monolithic ad serving systems into 12+ microservices, reducing deployment complexity and enabling independent scaling of ad targeting and bidding modules.  
- **Linux Administration**: Automated server provisioning for ad platform nodes, cutting deployment time from hours to minutes. Monitored system performance using Prometheus, resolving 98% of bottlenecks before they impacted users.  
- **Monitoring & Alerting**: Implemented Grafana dashboards for real-time ad campaign health, enabling proactive issue resolution and reducing downtime by 75%.  
- **Docker**: Containerized ad processing pipelines, achieving 30% faster deployment cycles and consistent environments across development, staging, and production.

- Architected microservices for ad inventory management, reducing deployment friction by 50% and enabling seamless integration with third-party ad networks.

- Deployed Dockerized applications on AWS ECS, achieving 99.95% service availability and reducing deployment errors by 80% through automated testing pipelines.  
- Collaborated with DevOps teams to implement monitoring tools, ensuring sub-second response times for ad delivery APIs under peak load.
